scope: Ordinary public-source investor review supplements the preserved TinySet/company evidence. This selected shortlist includes required named investment responsibility, dated/scoped cheque policy, stage focus and real founder routes. It is not exhaustive. Professional attribution is not automatically legal-counsel participation; collective, historical/current and firm-versus-round roles retain their qualifications. No provider execution or outreach was performed by this source review.

typical_cheque.scope: Firm-wide published cheque range, not actual TransBnk cheque or an offer.
typical_cheque.summary: Current official published firm range is USD1M–5M. This does not disclose Arkam contribution to the USD25M TransBnk round.

stage_focus.summary: Seed through Series B. Current generic strategy includes the example Series A. The comparable historical deal is Series B.

geography_focus.summary: India-focused strategy and the India comparable support the startup country; actual current investor interest remains unestablished.

investors.geography_fit_note: India investment strategy and the India-based payment/transaction-software comparable support geographic relevance, not guaranteed eligibility.

similar_companies.fit_summary: B2B transaction/payment APIs and SaaS supply a financial-infrastructure analogue, but serve banks and enterprises rather than only small merchants. The comparable was SeriesB; current firm policy includes the input SeriesA.
